metadata.description: Empirical evaluation suite for testing schema-linking, LLM hallucination interception, AST-level fuzzy auto-repair, and SQL-to-NoSQL transcompilation.

valid_analytical_sql.description: Wildcard projection over single base table

valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';

valid_analytical_sql.description: Compound boolean filter with date comparison and precedence
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE (city = 'Delhi' OR city = 'Mumbai') AND signup_date > '2024-01-01';

valid_analytical_sql.description: Two-table INNER JOIN on validated foreign key
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT c.name, o.order_date, o.status FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'DELIVERED';

valid_analytical_sql.description: Two-table LEFT JOIN with table aliases
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT c.name, o.id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city;

valid_analytical_sql.description: Aggregation with HAVING post-filter and ordering
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY city ASC;

valid_analytical_sql.description: Multiple aggregation functions (SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity), AVG(price), MIN(price), MAX(price) FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id;

valid_analytical_sql.description: Multi-table join across orders and order_items
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, oi.quantity, oi.price FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.quantity >= 2;

valid_analytical_sql.description: Single-table projection with ORDER BY and LIMIT
valid_analytical_sql.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10;

schema_hallucinations.sql: SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';
SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2024-01-01';
SELECT id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED';

schema_hallucinations.description: Plausible table hallucination (users instead of customers)
schema_hallucinations.sql: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE city = 'Delhi';

schema_hallucinations.description: Plausible table hallucination (invoices instead of orders)
schema_hallucinations.sql: SELECT invoice_id, amount FROM invoices WHERE status = 'PAID';

schema_hallucinations.description: Plausible column hallucination in WHERE clause (phone)
schema_hallucinations.sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE phone = '9876543210';

schema_hallucinations.description: Plausible column hallucination in GROUP BY clause (country)
schema_hallucinations.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;
SELECT c.name, o.id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.cust_number;
SELECT name, discount_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Apparel';
SELECT address, zip_code FROM customers WHERE city = 'Bangalore';

semantic_and_type_violations.description: Incompatible comparison: DATE column compared with INT literal
semantic_and_type_violations.sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date = 42;

semantic_and_type_violations.description: Incompatible comparison: VARCHAR column compared with numerical operator
semantic_and_type_violations.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status > 100;

semantic_and_type_violations.description: GROUP BY inconsistency: non-aggregated column missing in GROUP BY list
semantic_and_type_violations.sql: SELECT city, signup_date, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city;

semantic_and_type_violations.description: Invalid join: joining tables with no foreign key relationship
semantic_and_type_violations.sql: SELECT c.name, p.name FROM customers c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.id;

semantic_and_type_violations.description: Column ambiguity in multi-table join without table qualifier
semantic_and_type_violations.sql: SELECT id, name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;

fuzzy_typo_repair.description: Foreign key column typo: cust_id -> customer_id (distance 4 in alias context)
fuzzy_typo_repair.sql: SELECT c.name, o.status FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.cust_id;

fuzzy_typo_repair.description: Column typo with edit distance 1: nam -> name
fuzzy_typo_repair.sql: SELECT nam, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';

fuzzy_typo_repair.description: Column typo with edit distance 1: stauts -> status
fuzzy_typo_repair.sql: SELECT id, stauts FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 101;

fuzzy_typo_repair.description: Column typo with edit distance 1: qunatity -> quantity
fuzzy_typo_repair.sql: SELECT product_id, qunatity FROM order_items WHERE price > 500;

fuzzy_typo_repair.description: Column typo with edit distance 1: catgory -> category
fuzzy_typo_repair.sql: SELECT id, name FROM products WHERE catgory = 'Books';

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: Transpile SQL equality filter to MongoDB find() with $eq
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: Transpile SQL relational bounds to MongoDB find() with $gt and $lt
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100 AND price <= 1000;

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: Transpile SQL ORDER BY and LIMIT to chained .sort() and .limit()
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT name, city FROM customers ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 10;

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: Transpile SQL GROUP BY to MongoDB $group aggregation stage
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city;

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: Transpile SQL JOIN to MongoDB $lookup and $unwind pipeline stages
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT c.name, o.status FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: Transpile SQL HAVING clause to post-$group $match stage
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

nosql_transpilation_coverage.description: End-to-end full SQL transpilation: JOIN + WHERE + GROUP BY + HAVING + ORDER BY + LIMIT
nosql_transpilation_coverage.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Delhi' GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY c.name ASC LIMIT 10;
